name: jdr-frontend
description: JDR single-page application (Svelte 5 + TypeScript + Vite). Development only: the build output goes to ../assets and ../sw.js.

scripts.check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json
scripts.typecheck: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json
